[[File:Atsuhiro Tomioka.png|thumb|180px|Atsuhiro Tomioka]] '''Atsuhiro Tomioka''' ({{j|冨岡淳広}} ''Tomioka Atsuhiro'') was born on November 25, 1967[https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/people.php?id=1623 Atsuhiro TOMIOKA - Anime News Network]. He is a screenwriter who has worked with {{aniseries|PTS}} since its beginning until its end. ==Credits== ===TV series=== :''See: {{cat|Episodes written by Atsuhiro Tomioka}}''
Atsuhiro Tomioka has written over 200 episodes of {{aniseries|PTS}}, his first episode being ''[[EP003|Ash Catches a Pokémon]]''. ===Movies=== * ''[[M23|Secrets of the Jungle]]'' ===Specials=== * ''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]'' * ''{{OBP|Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs|animated special}}'' * ''[[Hoopa — The Mischief Pokémon]]'' ===Shorts=== * ''[[PK26|Pikachu, What's This Key?]]'' ===Web series=== * [[Pokémon Generations]] (all episodes) ==Other non-Pokémon works== * '''{{wp|Brave Exkaiser}}''' (1990-1991) -
